notes: AppConfig.init(from:) line 744-746 decodes `servers` as a plain `[ConfigServer].self` array with no id-uniqueness pass at all -- `remoteAPISharedAccess` gets a dedupe pass (lines 779-792) immediately next to this in the same initializer, but `servers` deliberately does not. Two entries sharing the same id both survive decode unmerged and unmodified; this pins that AppConfig itself never treats server-id collisions the way it treats shared-access-token collisions.
